description: S34 T4's one genuinely new daemon behavior: an operator-triggered probe of one configured server — initialize + tools/list only, never tools/call (asserted against a fake transport, not in prose). Single-flight per server name, bounded by internal/mcp.DefaultProbeTimeout (5s, a fixed constant — the config schema has no per-server timeout field to read), and cached with checkedAt so mcp.status can show the age of the last check rather than a fake live badge.

tools.name: list_issues
tools.description: List open issues in a repository
